---
description: 'Placeholder frontend used by the platform scaffold. Replace with your own.'
labels: ['placeholder', 'scaffold', 'app', 'react']
---

A scaffold-only frontend used by the platform generator so that newly-created
platforms boot out of the box. It is intentionally minimal and is **not meant
for production use** — replace it with your own frontend app in your
platform's `.bit-app` file.
